hooks.logic:
Count up "currentTurn".
Count up "fingerTipTurn".
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "flightAttack" this frame.
Let currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo be the phase matching the current form of the enemy under the phases list.
Let paramSuffixNo be list at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'paramSuffixNo'.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases list.
If condition flag "self_tornado" is up this frame, then
  Set the register's 'isFirstSelfTornado' to true.
  The enemy → set with ("hp", 1).
If condition flag "haste" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isNextAbilityHaste' to false.
If condition flag "fingerTip" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isAblityFingerTip' to true.
If condition flag "tornado" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isNextAbilityHaste' to true.
If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then
  Let v be false.
  For each x in resultObjectsInFrame
    If x's 'isFlightAttack', then set v to true.
  If v, then call helper with (this state, paramSuffixNo).
If paramSuffixNo is not paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  Set the register's 'hasChangedToMad' to true and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'jumpCounter' is at least the numeric entry "number_of_jumps" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy and paramSuffixNo is "2" and not the register's 'isFirstSelfTornado', then
    Let ability be the id of the move labelled "selfTornado" on the enemy.
    The enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "06"}]]}}, {abilityId: ability}] and stop.
  If the register's 'isAblityFingerTip' and increased the register's 'countTurnAfterFingerTip' is at least the numeric entry "atb_full_count" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then
    Set the register's 'countTurnAfterFingerTip' to 0.
    Set the register's 'isAblityFingerTip' to false.
    The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_01"}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: "3"}], [{builtin: "RESET_CAST_ABILITY"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    Choose state 14 next and stop.
  If the register's 'isNextAbilityHaste', then the enemy uses the move labelled "haste" and stop.
  If not call helper2 with (this state), then
    Let v2 be unset.
    Let number be the numeric entry list at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'fingerTipLotTurn' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
    If the count "fingerTipTurn" is less than number, then
      Let excludedAbilityListBySmartLot be the enemy → get-excluded-ability-list-by-smart-lot.
      Append (the id of the move labelled "fingertip" on the enemy) to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
      Set v2 to a weighted random move of the enemy other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
    Otherwise, set v2 to a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
    The enemy uses v2.

Count up "currentTurn".
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "flightAttack" this frame.
Let conditionFlagInFrame be condition flag "counter" is up this frame.
If condition flag "haste" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isNextAbilityHaste' to false.
If condition flag "tornado" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isNextAbilityHaste' to true.
If the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_2" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy and the register's 'nextParamSuffixNoForTornado' is "1", then
  Set the register's 'nextParamSuffixNoForTornado' to "2".
  Set the register's 'hasChangedToMad' to true.
If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then
  Let v be false.
  For each x in resultObjectsInFrame
    If x's 'isFlightAttack', then set v to true.
  If v, then
    Call helper with (this state, currentParamSuffixNo).
    The enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{deformTag: "deformation_02"}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: the register's 'nextParamSuffixNoForTornado'}], [{builtin: "RESET_CAST_ABILITY"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
    Choose state 13 next and stop.
  If conditionFlagInFrame, then
    Let v2 be a random pick from ["counterTornado", "fingertip"].
    The enemy → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with (v2, {isCounter: true}, {interruptCounter: true}).
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'isNextAbilityHaste', then the enemy uses the move labelled "haste" and stop.
  Otherwise
    If not call helper2 with (this state), then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
    Stop.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be false.
If call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.get with (arg, "currentTurn") is the numeric entry "turns_of_tornado" in the battle settings of the group of executer, then set v to true.
Otherwise, if call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.get with (arg, "currentTurn") mod the numeric entry "every_turn_tornado" in the battle settings of the group of executer equals 0 and call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.get with (arg, "currentTurn") is at most the numeric entry "change_interval_turn_to_tornado" in the battle settings of the group of executer, then set v to true.
Otherwise, if (call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.get with (arg, "currentTurn") minus the numeric entry "change_interval_turn_to_tornado" in the battle settings of the group of executer) mod the numeric entry "every_turn_tornado_2" in the battle settings of the group of executer equals 0 and call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.get with (arg, "currentTurn") is more than the numeric entry "change_interval_turn_to_tornado" in the battle settings of the group of executer, then set v to true.
If v, then executer uses the move labelled "tornado".
Return v.
